questions.q: Which organ is shown in this slide?
questions.explain: A spongy red meshwork of cords and sinusoids, with rounded dark lymphoid areas where visible, indicates the spleen.
questions.alt: A dense meshwork of cells with small dark nuclei surrounds pale irregular spaces.

questions.q: What is the spongy red meshwork of this organ called?
options: Medullary cords of a lymph node
questions.explain: Red pulp consists of splenic cords and sinusoids full of blood cells.
questions.alt: A dense meshwork of cells with small dark nuclei surrounds pale irregular spaces.

questions.q: How can spleen be told from lymph node?
options: Spleen has red and white pulp and no subcapsular sinus
Spleen has a cortex with follicles and a medulla with cords
Spleen has afferent lymphatic vessels entering the capsule
questions.explain: A lymph node has cortex, medulla and sinuses; the spleen has red and white pulp.
questions.alt: A dense meshwork of cells with small dark nuclei surrounds pale irregular spaces.
